arxiv-2305-08812.title: Slow Down, Move Over: A Case Study in Formal Verification, Refinement, and Testing of the Responsibility-Sensitive Safety Model for Self-Driving Cars
arxiv-2305-08812.creator: Megan Strauss, Stefan Mitsch
arxiv-2305-08812.description: Abstract Technology advances give us the hope of driving without human error, reducing vehicle emissions and simplifying an everyday task with the future of self-driving cars. Making sure these vehicles are safe is very important to the continuation of this field.

arxiv-2311-11174.title: Feshbach resonance of heavy exciton-polaritons
arxiv-2311-11174.creator: B. Vermilyea and M.M. Fogler Department of Physics, University of California San Diego, 9500 Gilman Drive, La Jolla, California, 92093, USA
arxiv-2311-11174.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by B. Vermilyea and M.M. Fogler Department of Physics, University of California San Diego, 9500 Gilman Drive, La Jolla, California, 92093, USA. We study interactions between polaritons formed by hybridization of excitons in a two-dimensional (2D) semiconductor with surface optical phonons or plasmons. These quasiparticles have a high effective mass and can bind into bipolaritons near a Feshbach-like scattering resonance.

arxiv-2402-17720.title: The 𝖲𝖬𝖠𝖱𝖳 \mathsf{SMART} Approach to Instance-Optimal Online Learning
arxiv-2402-17720.creator: Siddhartha Banerjee, Alankrita Bhatt, Christina Lee Yu
arxiv-2402-17720.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Siddhartha Banerjee, Alankrita Bhatt, Christina Lee Yu. We devise an online learning algorithm – titled Switching via Monotone Adapted Regret Traces ( 𝖲𝖬𝖠𝖱𝖳 \mathsf{SMART} ) – that adapts to the data and achieves regret that is instance optimal , i.e., simultaneously competitive on every input sequence compared to the performance of the follow-the-leader ( 𝖥𝖳𝖫 \mathsf{FTL} ) policy and the worst case guarantee of any other input policy 𝖠𝖫𝖦 𝖶𝖢 \mathsf{ALG}_{\mathsf{WC}} .

arxiv-2502-19961.title: High-contrast spectroscopy with the new VLT/ERIS instrument Thanks: Based on observations collected at the European Organisation for Astronomical Research in the Southern Hemisphere under ESO program 112.2628.002.
arxiv-2502-19961.creator: J. Hayoz ,, M. J. Bonse, F. Dannert, E. O. Garvin, G. Cugno, P. Patapis, T. D. Gebhard, W. O. Balmer, R. J. De Rosa, A. Agudo Berbel, Y. Cao, G. Orban de Xivry, T. Stolker, R. Davies, O. Absil ,, H. M. Schmid, S. P. Quanz, G. Agapito, A. Baruffolo, M. Black, M. Bonaglia, R. Briguglio, L. Carbonaro,
arxiv-2502-19961.description: Abstract Context. The Enhanced Resolution Imager and Spectrograph (ERIS) is the new adaptive optics (AO) assisted infrared instrument at the Very Large Telescope (VLT). Its refurbished integral field spectrograph (IFS) SPIFFIER leverages a new AO module, enabling high-contrast imaging applications and giving access to the orbital and atmospheric characterisation of super-Jovian exoplanets. Aims.

arxiv-2508-17859.title: Certificates and Witnesses for Multi-objective ω \omega -regular Queries in Markov Decision Processes Thanks: The authors were supported by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) within the project SEMECO Q1 (03ZU1210AG) and by the German Research Foundation (DFG) through the C
arxiv-2508-17859.creator: Christel Baier, Calvin Chau, Volodymyr Drobitko, Simon Jantsch, Sascha Klüppelholz
arxiv-2508-17859.description: Abstract Multi-objective probabilistic model checking is a powerful technique for verifying stochastic systems against multiple (potentially conflicting) properties. To enhance the trustworthiness and explainability of model checking tools, we present independently checkable certificates and witnesses for multi-objective ω \omega -regular queries in Markov decision processes.

arxiv-2512-16387.title: Orbital-related gyrotropic responses in Cu 2 WSe 4 and chirality indicator
arxiv-2512-16387.creator: Kazuki Nakazawa, Terufumi Yamaguchi, Ai Yamakage
arxiv-2512-16387.description: Abstract In recent years, counterparts of phenomena studied in spintronics have been actively explored in the orbital sector. The relationship between orbital degrees of freedom and crystal chirality has also been intensively investigated, although the distinction from gyrotropic properties has not been fully clarified.

arxiv-2601-08509.title: What If TSF : A Benchmark for Reframing Forecasting as Scenario-Guided Multimodal Forecasting
arxiv-2601-08509.creator: Jinkwan Jang, Hyunbin Jin, Hyungjin Park, Kyubyung Chae, Taesup KimGraduate School of Data Science, Seoul National University {jkjang22, hyunbin.jin, robin5310, kyubyung.chae, taesup.kim}@snu.ac.kr
arxiv-2601-08509.description: Abstract Time series forecasting is critical to real-world decision making, yet most existing approaches remain unimodal and rely on extrapolating historical patterns. While recent progress in large language models (LLMs) highlights the potential for multimodal forecasting, existing benchmarks largely provide retrospective or misaligned raw context, making it unclear whether such models meaningfully leverage textual inputs.

arxiv-2602-17209.title: Hierarchical Edge-Cloud Task Offloading in NTN for Remote Healthcare
arxiv-2602-17209.creator: Alejandro Flores ∗ ; Danial Shafaie + , Konstantinos Ntontin ∗ , Elli Kartsakli + , Symeon Chatzinotas ∗
arxiv-2602-17209.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Alejandro Flores ∗ ; Danial Shafaie + , Konstantinos Ntontin ∗ , Elli Kartsakli + , Symeon Chatzinotas ∗. In this work, we study a hierarchical non-terrestrial network as an edge-cloud platform for remote computing of tasks generated by remote ad-hoc healthcare facility deployments, or internet of medical things (IoMT) devices.

pmc-10738643.title: AGE-FRIENDLY PARTNER EVALUATION: REVIEWING FLORIDA ACTION PLANS
pmc-10738643.creator: Helena Swanson
pmc-10738643.description: Understanding community collaboration is crucial to advance age-friendly community change (Greenfield, et al., 2022). This poster’s purpose is to provide evidence about age-friendly partner involvement to bring awareness to the extent that partnerships are collaborative and holistic at the age-friendly action plan stage.

pmc-11344700.title: Clinical significance of FLC tests in patients without other evidence of hematologic disorder
pmc-11344700.creator: Dor Shpitzer, Yael C Cohen, Chava Perry, Guy Melamed, Hillel Alapi, Anat Reiner-Benaim, Irit Avivi
pmc-11344700.description: The clinical significance of an abnormal free light chain (FLC) test, performed due to unspecific complains in the absence of a known plasma cell dyscrasia (PCD) or lymphoproliferative disease (LPD), is not fully elucidated. We investigated the importance of an abnormal FLC ratio (FLC-R) in this setting.

pmc-11447256.title: Cell fixation improves performance of in situ crosslinking mass spectrometry while preserving cellular ultrastructure
pmc-11447256.creator: Andrew R M Michael, Bruno C Amaral, Kallie L Ball, Kristen H Eiriksson, David C Schriemer
pmc-11447256.description: Crosslinking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) has the potential to map the interactome of the cell with high resolution and depth of coverage. However, current in vivo XL-MS methods are hampered by crosslinkers that demonstrate low cell permeability and require long reaction times.

pmc-12555581.title: Public Health Awareness & Early Detection of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis in Med Students
pmc-12555581.creator: S Cuschieri, S Grech
pmc-12555581.description: BackgroundAdolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) affects 0.47%-5.2% of adolescents globally. Early detection prevents severe deformities, chronic pain, and respiratory issues. Gaps in AIS knowledge among future doctors may delay diagnosis, increase healthcare burdens, and hinder timely intervention. This study assesses AIS awareness among Maltese medical students to inform educational and policy strategies for improved early detection and management.

pmc-12563135.title: Role of Mast Cells and Their Mediators in Chronic Kidney Diseases
pmc-12563135.creator: Maria Tziastoudi, Christos Cholevas, Theodoros Eleftheriadis, Ioannis Stefanidis, Theoharis C Theoharides, Giovanna Traina
pmc-12563135.description: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) affects as many as 10% of the population, which translates to about 850 million globally. Even though genetics, diabetes, and hypertension contribute to CKD, the underlying pathologic processes remain poorly understood. Mast cells (MCs) are unique tissue immune cells capable of secreting numerous biologically active molecules.

pmc-12612916.title: Photoprotective Properties of Extracts Derived from Neoglaziovia variegata (Arruda) Mez Incorporated into Mesoporous TiO2
pmc-12612916.creator: Francisco A. A. Miranda, Vaeudo V. Oliveira, Roosevelt D. S. Bezerra, Josy A. Osajima, Edson C. Silva-Filho
pmc-12612916.description: The development of safe and effective photoprotective agents has gained increasing interest in recent years, particularly through the incorporation of natural compounds into inorganic matrices. In this study, sunscreen formulations were developed by incorporating Neoglaziovia variegata (Arruda) Mez extracts into mesoporous TiO2, using different solvent fractions: ethyl acetate, ethanol, chloroform, and hexane.

pmc-12660940.title: Integrating whole genome and transcriptome sequencing to characterize the genetic architecture of isoform variation
pmc-12660940.creator: Chunyu Liu, Roby Joehanes, Jiantao Ma, Jiuyong Xie, Jian Yang, Mengyao Wang, Tianxiao Huan, Shih-Jen Hwang, Jia Wen, Quan Sun, Cumhur Y Demirkale, Nancy L Heard-Costa, Peter Orchard, April P Carson, Jeffrey W Haessler, Laura M Raffield, Alex P Reiner, Nora Franceschini, Paul L Auer, Charles Kooperbe
pmc-12660940.description: We present a whole-blood isoform ratio QTL (irQTL) resource by analyzing genome-wide isoform-to-gene expression ratios using sequencing data. In Framingham Heart Study (FHS, n = 2622) discovery, we identify over 1.1 million cis-irQTLs (minor allele frequency [MAF] ≥ 0.01, ±1 Mb of 10,883 isoform transcripts, P < 5 × 10−8) across 4,971 genes.

pmc-12705818.title: Research on parameter optimization design of coreless transformer based on genetic algorithm
pmc-12705818.creator: Wenshuang Qin, Yi Zhang, Yufang Lu
pmc-12705818.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study found that the inter-coil spacing (H) of a coreless transformer, the operating frequency (f0), the load (RL) on the transformer’s secondary circuit, and the actual operating frequency (f) all affect the transmission efficiency (η) of the transformer. To address this, a random forest regression model was used to predict the transmission efficiency (η) as a function of the parameters (f0, H, RL, f).

pmc-13088974.title: Kappa Free Light Chains Reflect Treatment Response and Progression Independent of Focal Inflammation in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-13088974.creator: Igal Rosenstein, Markus Axelsson, Magnus Johnsson, Clas Malmeström, Hlin Kvartsberg, Henrik Zetterberg, Jan Lycke, Lenka Novakova
pmc-13088974.description: BackgroundCerebrospinal fluid (CSF) kappa free light chains (KFLC) is a sensitive marker of intrathecal immunoglobulin synthesis and is incorporated into the 2024 McDonald criteria for multiple sclerosis (MS). How disease‐modifying therapies (DMTs) influence KFLC dynamics and their association with treatment response remains unclear.ObjectiveTo determine whether intrathecal KFLC synthesis changes during DMT and whether these changes are associated with clinical outcomes.

pmc-13219174.title: The influence of sense of agency on learning structured regularities: an artificial grammar learning study
pmc-13219174.creator: Romina Haxhi, Mateusz Woźniak, Agnieszka Wykowska
pmc-13219174.description: In many real-life situations learning is an active process of engaging with new information, experimenting and integrating new experiences to build meaningful understanding. However, learning can have either a more active or more passive form and several factors may influence how effectively individuals learn new information in both cases.

pmc-13398710.title: GhSCAMP13 Negatively Modulates Salt Tolerance Through GhNHX7b‐Dependent Na+ Homeostasis in Cotton
pmc-13398710.creator: Haohong Tang, Zhaojie He, Cong Sun, Haonan Shi, Zhan Gao, Yanlong Jin, Wenting Ji, Linfu Feng, Ning Wang, Zunzhe Tian, Guanjing Hu, Jie Sun, Xianpeng Xiong
pmc-13398710.description: fibre crop, cotton exhibits moderate salt tolerance but remains threatened by high salinity (Abdelraheem et al. 2019). Secretory carrier membrane proteins (SCAMPs) are a highly conserved family of tetraspanins regulating vesicle trafficking (Law et al. 2012), with emerging links to plant responses to abiotic stress (He et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2023).

pmc-13642462.title: Spatial and spectrotemporal features of noise alter female responses to costly male signals in Cope’s gray treefrog (Hyla chrysoscelis)
pmc-13642462.creator: Jessica L Ward, Norman Lee, Lata Kalra, Mark A Bee
pmc-13642462.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In anuran choruses, where many males call simultaneously, females must identify attractive conspecific signals amid high levels of background noise. We tested whether spatial separation between signals and noise (spatial release from masking, SRM) and spectrotemporally correlated amplitude fluctuations in noise (comodulation masking release, CMR) influence mate choice behavior and help females maintain preferences for energetically costly calls under noisy conditions.
